name: arith_dvd_sum_coprime
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : n ∣ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n with k.Coprime n, k
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n), n ∣ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n with k.Coprime n, k
informal: For n ≥ 3 the sum of the totatives of n is divisible by n — Uses Mathlib2.nt2_two_mul_sum_coprime_eq_mul_totient at step 1: 2·S = n·φ(n); φ(n) is even for n > 2 (Nat.totient_even), so S = n·(φ(n)/2).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → n ∣ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n with k.Coprime n, k
